title: Know Your Taxpayer

pages.text: Side Quest 1, from the top! Talk to the four clients in the plaza and collect their profiles, then come find me.
Collect all four profiles. Your tracker counts them for you.
All four sorted! Now the mastery run: same quest, no hand. Aim for zero wrong corners!
Mastery run! Collect, then sort. Listen to every client: where are they from, and where do they live?
Collect all four profiles in the plaza.
Find me in the plaza and talk to me to open the corkboard.
Sort all four cards. Go for zero wrong corners!
You know your taxpayers! That's the heart of this job.
